thread:
ashwin: paging — we're seeing a sharp spike in token verification failures across multiple regions. frontend auth returns 502/403 for interactive logins and service-to-service token introspect is failing. console access affected for some customers. triage started. :rotating_light:

infra-bot: incident created: INC-2765123480 — PagerDuty page sent to oncall.

marie (sre): seeing this in the auth-verify service logs: `upstream "okta-introspect" returned 502` repeatedly, rate ~1200/s for the last 3m, error rate 48%.

ashwin: confirmed. token-introspect latency also jumped to 6s before errors. datadog alerts for auth-verify are firing but traces are sparse — looks like our logging/ingest into observability is lagging.

sophia (product): customer reports: "cannot login to console, all team members blocked" — high-severity support tickets flagged.

eve (support): notifying affected customers in parallel, have a template ready to post to status.redwood.ai — will wait for confirmed mitigation steps.

marie (sre): digging into root cause — okta telemetry shows a surge in 5xx responses from their introspect endpoint from our tenant. Also seeing intermittent JWKS 504s when we retrieve keys.

ashwin: try a quick local introspect to reproduce.

marie (sre): ```bash
# from a host in us-west-2
curl -v -X POST https://redwood.okta.introspect.example.com/token -d 'token=REDACTED'
* Connected to okta...\n< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n{"error":"server_error","error_description":"upstream failure"}
```

ashwin: ok. looks like Okta is returning 502 for introspect and our code bubble-ups that to callers. Are we still using the primary Okta cluster without fallback?

marie (sre): current client has two behaviors: prefetched JWKS for sig verification, and introspect as fallback. Prefetch is failing because JWKS fetch returns 504 intermittently. Introspect returns 502 on POSTs. We have a short-circuit cached-jwks path but TTL is low (5m) and our cache eviction happened ~2m ago.

ashwin: plan: 1) increase JWKS TTL in runtime to 30m temporarily, 2) enable cached-jwks fallback mode for introspect path, 3) route internal admin /console-auth to fallback service-account verification that uses long-lived service tokens. Need someone to patch runtime config and roll.

marie (sre): i can patch the config in the infra config repo and do a hot reload on the auth-verify fleet. small change:
```yaml
auth_verify:
  jwks_cache_ttl: 1800  # seconds (was 300)
  allow_stale_jwks: true
```

ashwin: post the exact deploy command once ready. i'll coordinate the rollout and monitor.

deploy-bot: ran canary deploy of auth-verify:v2.3.14 to 2 instances in us-west-2. health checks pass.

marie (sre): rolling change to all pods now (parallelism=5). watching error rate.

(90s later)

marie (sre): quick update — error rate dropped from 48% to 12% after enabling stale JWKS and increasing TTL. introspect 502s still present but much reduced. latency back down to ~220ms on successful checks.

ashwin: good. next: we should open a high-severity ticket with Okta and provide correlation ids and timestamps. eve, can you open the support ticket and paste the case number here? Include sample curl logs and trace ids.

eve (support): opened Okta case: 0123456789. Submitted logs + sample token traces + timestamps. I've asked for ETA and root cause. pinging Okta via chat support.

okta-support-bot: auto-reply from Okta: "We're seeing elevated errors on introspect for multiple tenants — engineering investigating. Suggested mitigations: enable JWKS caching and reduce JWKS refresh frequency; fail open to cached keys temporarily."

ashwin: Okta acknowledged. we'll keep the cache fallback for now. second mitigation: create a traffic rule to prefer regional introspect endpoints (eu vs us) to reduce cross-region failures — can we add that?

marie (sre): adding routing policy now: prefer-region introspect with fallback to same-region cached jwks. Config change applied to edge-router.

ashwin: support status update: eve, send interim status: impacted customers: console login and service token introspect failures in US and EU, mitigated partially by config change, working on durable fix with Okta. Use P1 template. :memo:

eve (support): posted status update and emailed top 20 affected customers. copying the message here: "We are currently experiencing authentication failures due to upstream Okta errors. We've implemented temporary caching and routing mitigations which have reduced failures; some users may still experience login errors. We will update as Okta provides progress."

sophia (product): any need to consider credits or SLA gestures? might be required for customers with interrupted workflows. please gather affected tenant list.

marie (sre): extracting impacted tenant IDs from logs now; will attach CSV to the incident ticket.

ashwin: one more note — our observability ingest lag made this noisier. open ticket with observability vendor (datadog/heap) after this stabilizes to ensure alerts are reliable. create follow-up action item.

marie (sre): agree. creating postmortem stub and linking this incident.

ashwin: good work team. monitoring for full recovery. will escalate to SEs if Okta doesn't provide ETA within 30m. :phone_construction:

(End of thread)
